meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

copy.tagline: 设计低噪声量子电路,并在谷歌量子处理器上运行实验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在量子计算领域做研发,需要设计面向谷歌量子芯片的自定义电路。
copy.tagline_en: Build noise-resilient quantum circuits and run experiments on Google quantum hardware.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're researching quantum and need to run custom circuits on Google chips.

howto.what: Claude 会用 Cirq 在 Python 里帮你搭建和模拟量子线路、跑参数扫描、建模噪声,并把线路编译到 Google 等硬件后端。
howto.when: 当你面向 Google Quantum AI 硬件、设计噪声感知线路,或做量子表征实验时会用它;涉及 NISQ 线路等场景也会触发。

say.text: 用 Cirq 搭一个两比特的贝尔态线路并模拟 1000 次
say.note: 会输出测量结果的直方图

say.text: 给这条线路加上退极化噪声,比较不同噪声水平下的结果
say.note: 用密度矩阵模拟做对比

say.text: 把这条线路编译到 Google 硬件并提交运行
say.note: 需要 GCP 项目和处理器 ID

howto.what_en: Claude uses Cirq in Python to build and simulate quantum circuits, run parameter sweeps, model noise, and compile circuits for hardware backends such as Google's.
howto.when_en: Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments; also for NISQ circuit work.

say_en.text: Build a two-qubit Bell state circuit in Cirq and simulate 1000 shots
Add depolarizing noise to this circuit and compare noise levels
Compile this circuit for Google hardware and submit it
say_en.note: Needs a GCP project and processor ID
